articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Okta Ties AI Agent Kill Switch To Identity Valuation Opportunity. Okta's CEO has outlined a new security framework for AI agents, introducing an enterprise "kill switch" for instant access revocation. The framework calls for stricter access controls and human approval for sensitive AI driven actions as enterprise AI adoption grows. This move is intended to position Okta (NasdaqGS:OKTA) as a core security layer for companies deploying AI in critical workflows.
